description: This file defines the IfTokenParser class which parses 'if' conditional blocks in Twig templates, converting template syntax into nodes for rendering logic.

classes.name: Twig	okenParser\IfTokenParser
classes.description: Final class that extends AbstractTokenParser to handle parsing of 'if' blocks in Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an 'if' statement token and its conditional branches, returning an IfNode representing the conditional structure.

methods.name: decideIfFork
methods.description: Determines if the current token is 'elseif', 'else', or 'endif' to decide branch parsing.

methods.name: decideIfEnd
methods.description: Checks if the current token is 'endif' to mark the end of the 'if' block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this parser, which is 'if'.
